chapter_seo_title: Immortal Fortunes Assembly Round Two – Ji Ning Wins, But a Blade Servant Steals the Show
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning collects his Immortal-ranked treasure and cruises through Round One, but a barefoot formation master and a silent blade-wielding wanderer shock everyone in Round Two. Lu Dongbin sets up Ji Ning vs. Daonu!
og_title: Ji Ning vs. the Blade Servant – The Immortal Fortunes Assembly Just Got Real
og_description: Sword Immortal meets Saber Maniac as Lu Dongbin arranges the ultimate Dao duel. Read the full match breakdown.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Takes on a Blade Servant – Who Will Win?
twitter_description: The top twenty-four are set, and a mysterious blade-wielder shocks everyone. Next up: Ji Ning vs. Daonu!

lore_anchors.definition: A classified magic treasure of the Immortal grade, forged from celestial materials and bearing the power of Pure Yang True Immortals. Low-grade versions are standard for top-forty-eight prizes at the Assembly; higher grades can split worlds.
A portable formation array created using staves modeled after the mythical Fuxi's trigrams. A master can deploy it instantly to trap, suppress, or seal opponents without direct combat.
The highest Ki Refining realm within the Three Realms, achieved after successfully undergoing the Heavenly Tribulation and transcending the Five Elements. Equivalent to an Empyrean God in power.

One of the exalted Grand Daos, celebrated for its fierce, domineering offense. A cultivator who fully comprehends it is called a Saber Immortal (or Saber Maniac) and can rival Sword Immortals in combat.
Literally “Blade Servant” or “Saber Slave.” A cultivator’s self-chosen Daoist title signifying total devotion to the Saber Dao, willing to be its servant.
